E0, Ed, E1, Ed-1 eliminate v5,a,c5,b by invertible formal derivatives. The two transverse leading forms are quadratic q2 and cubic q3; at a valid Fermat point with weights (1,1,-3), independently computed dehomogenized resultant Res(q2,q3)=8/81≠0. Their regular-sequence quotient in two variables has Hilbert series (1-t²)(1-t³)/(1-t)²=1+2t+2t²+t³, length 6, and kills transverse order >=4. Therefore E_k (k>=4) add no constraints for d>=6, while d=5 has no other residual equations. Yu Theorem 1.3 supplies global component dimension <=2 and the cone family supplies dimension 2; result concerns generic local Artin length, not every special point.
